name: anim_trio_cuddle_loop
subject: a pink paint goo Doberman monster hugging a pink paint goo crocodile monster tightly, on a sticky paint puddle
desc: Loop: the Doberman keeps hugging the crocodile tightly and squeezing it again and again, rubbing its cheek against it, the two cuddling closely like an affectionate couple; their goo bodies squish and bulge together with each squeeze, sticky goo strands stretching between them and dripping into the puddle. Eyes half-closed and content. They stay in place. Heavy, sticky, gooey.
